def algorithm(func, dim, lb, ub, budget, rng):
    pop_size = 50
    alpha = 0.5
    pop = np.random.uniform(lb, ub, (pop_size, dim))
    best = None
    for _ in range(budget):
        fit = [func(x) for x in pop]
        fits = np.array(fit)
        maxfit = np.max(fits)
        if best is None or maxfit < func(best):
            best = pop[np.argmax(fits)]
        for i in range(pop_size):
            r1, r2, r3 = rng.choice(pop_size, 3, replace=False)
            mutation = alpha * (pop[r1] - pop[r2]) + pop[r3]
            mutation = np.clip(mutation, lb, ub)
            fit_new = func(mutation)
            if fit_new < fits[i]:
                pop[i] = mutation
    return best
